definition: Writing something down before you decide what to do about it. The bar at the top of every screen does this.
Where captured things wait until you decide. The goal is to empty it — not by doing the work, but by deciding.
The decision itself: is this an action, a project, something someone owes you, a maybe, or nothing?
One concrete physical step you could take right now: "Ring the venue about the deposit", not "Sort out the offsite".
Where or with what you would do an action — @calls, @computer, @errands, @home. You look at the list that matches where you are.
Any outcome that needs more than one action. "Team offsite" is a project; "Draft three bullet points" is an action.
A project with no open next action. It cannot move, so the app says so instead of letting it sit quietly.
Something another person owes you. Recording it frees your head; the app counts the days.
Ideas that are not commitments. Parked deliberately, with a note about why.
The dating system. A dated action steps out of its list until the morning of that day, then comes back on its own.
The section where actions with a future date wait. They are not forgotten — they are held back.
A guided pass over the whole system, about once a week, so nothing rots.
